biotools.summary: mosaicMPI is a framework for modular data integration across cohorts and -omics modalities, facilitating the discovery of molecular programs and integration within and across datasets to represent biological themes. The framework integrates data from various platforms, yielding a richly characterized landscape of biological themes.
